**State of Idaho**

**Office of the State Board of Education**

**This position may be filled prior to the closing date on the job posting. Applicants are encouraged to apply as soon as possible to be considered.**

**STATE OF IDAHO EMPLOYEES:** If you are a current or temporary State of Idaho employee you MUST apply through Luma Opportunities. Applying through the State of Idaho’s external career website will cause duplicate profiles and will slow the processing of your application for a new position.

**About the Agency:** The Idaho State Board of Education (Board) is established in the Idaho Constitution for the “general supervision of the state educational institutions and public school system.” State law charges the Board with the general supervision, governance and control of public schools and postsecondary institutions, including community colleges. The Board is comprised of eight members: seven appointed by the Governor, as well as the statewide elected superintendent of public instruction. The Office of the State Board of Education (OSBE) is charged with providing professional staff support to the Board and implementing the Board’s policies, programs, and initiatives.

**Summary:**

The Chief Information Officer (CIO) provides executive leadership for the Office of the State Board of Education’s Education Data and Information Technology (EDIT) function. The CIO establishes strategic direction, oversees technology and data services, and ensures that information systems, infrastructure, applications, data, cybersecurity, and user support effectively advance the mission of the Board and the Office.

The CIO leads a multidisciplinary team supporting enterprise technology and education data functions across the Office, including data governance and analytics, education data systems, application development, infrastructure and end-user support, information security, longitudinal data services, broadband and related programs, and technology project delivery. The position works across the Idaho education system and with state agencies, public education institutions, school districts, charter schools, vendors, and other partners.

The CIO is responsible for technology strategy, operational performance, fiscal stewardship, risk management, data privacy and security, continuity and disaster recovery, major initiatives, vendor and contract oversight, and effective service delivery. The position provides executive-level advice on technology and data matters and represents the Office in statewide and external forums. The CIO is a strategic leader and people manager who provides direction and accountability rather than routinely performing hands-on technical work.

* Provides leadership and accountability for EDIT operations, including data governance, education data systems, application development, infrastructure, end-user support, information security, analytics, broadband-related technology programs, and technology project delivery.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Job description:

**Position Summary**

Serenity Home Health Care is seeking an experienced Director of Information Technology to lead and strengthen the company's internal IT operations. This person will be the senior internal technical owner for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, Azure Virtual Desktop, networking, endpoints, backups, cybersecurity controls, and technology vendors. The goal is to build strong internal IT ownership so Serenity can manage its environment directly while using outside vendors only where specialized support is needed.

What This Role Is Responsible For

The Director will lead the internal IT team, set technical standards, protect Serenity's technology interests, and make sure the organization can operate, monitor, secure, recover, and improve its system without depending entirely on one outside provider.

Cloud and Microsoft Environment

* Provide internal ownership and oversight for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD).
* Manage administrative access, role assignments, MFA, emergency access, and least-privilege controls.
* Oversee Azure subscriptions, resource access, monitoring, cost visibility, and technical documentation.
* Ensure AVD workspaces, host pools, session hosts, user access, images, patching, and support processes are properly managed.
* Help Serenity evaluate where AVD is still needed and where modern cloud-managed endpoints may be a better long-term solution.

Infrastructure, Network and Endpoints

* Oversee office connectivity, on-premises firewalls, VPNs, switching, Wi-Fi, DNS, and related network services.
* Work with the System Administrator and support staff to maintain reliable Windows devices,printers, servers, and business systems.
* Establish and maintain endpoint standards using Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, BitLocker, Defender, patching, and device compliance where adopted.
* Coordinate troubleshooting for major outages and make sure clear escalation procedures are in place.

Security, Backup and Recovery

* Work with Serenity leadership, compliance/GRC staff, and technical teams to turn security and HIPAA requirements into practical technical controls.
* Review privileged access, security alerts, audit logs, MFA, vendor access, and incident-response procedures.
* Ensure backup coverage is clearly documented and that backup failures are monitored and addressed.
* Make sure restore testing and disaster-recovery testing are performed and documented on a regular schedule.
* Maintain clear recovery procedures for critical systems and services.

IT Team and Vendor Leadership

* Lead and support Serenity's internal IT staff, including the System Administrator and other technical/support roles.
* Define responsibilities, priorities, escalation paths, documentation standards, and operating procedures for the IT team.
* Manage technical relationships with MSPs, cloud providers, security vendors, internet providers, software vendors, and other third parties.
* Review vendor work, access, deliverables, support performance, renewals, and technical dependencies.
* Ensure Serenity retains ownership of its accounts, documentation, configurations, data, backups, and administrative access.

Planning, Reporting and Business Support

* Prepare a practical IT roadmap covering cloud, endpoints, security, network, backup, licensing, and lifecycle planning.
* Monitor technology costs and work with leadership on budgets, licensing, renewals, and investment priorities.
* Provide clear updates to leadership on IT performance, risks, incidents, major projects, costs, and unresolved issues.
* Coordinate technology projects with department leaders while minimizing disruption to employees and business operations.
* Maintain accurate inventories, diagrams, procedures, support contacts, and change records.

**Qualifications**

* Required strong hands-on experience supporting Microsoft cloud and Windows environments.
* Required practical experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure administration, identity and access management, and Windows systems.
* Experience supporting or overseeing Azure Virtual Desktop, virtualization, or enterprise remote'desktop environments.
* Solid understanding of networking, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, endpoint security, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Experience leading technical staff, coordinating vendors, and managing business-critical IT services.
* Ability to explain technical problems and recommendations clearly to non-technical leadership.
* Strong documentation, troubleshooting, project-management, and communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in healthcare, home health, or another regulated environment.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Defender, Conditional Access, Windows Autopatch/Update forBusiness, and modern endpoint management.
* Experience with HIPAA-related technical safeguards, security reviews, incident response, and vendor access management.
* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-140, AZ-700, SC-300, or similar current cloud/security credentials.
* Experience managing a transition from vendor-led IT operations to a stronger internal IT operating model.

**First 90-Day Priorities**

1. Confirm Serenity-controlled administrative access and review all privileged accounts and vendor access.

2. Complete a current-state inventory of Microsoft, Azure/AVD, networks, servers, endpoints, backups, applications, vendors, and support responsibilities.

3. Confirm backup coverage and complete or schedule documented restore/disaster-recovery testing.

4. Review AVD operations, application dependencies, recurring issues, monitoring, and support procedures.

5. Establish a clear IT responsibility matrix for the Director, System Administrator, support staff, vendors, and leadership.

6. Create a short-term stabilization plan and a longer-term roadmap for Azure/AVD, cloud-managed endpoints, security, networking, and cost control.

7. Begin simple monthly reporting to leaders

jobs.description:
**Overview**

Deputy Director of Information Technology

**Boone County, Missouri**

Boone County is seeking an experienced technology leader to serve as **Deputy Director of Information Technology**. This is a senior leadership position responsible for supporting the Director in the strategic direction, administration, and day-to-day operations of the County’s technology services.

As second in command of the department, the Deputy Director plays a key role in shaping the County’s technology strategy, leading managers and major initiatives, overseeing critical support functions, and ensuring reliable, secure, and effective technology services across County government. This position serves as Director in their absence.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

* Supervise managers responsible for **Information Technology, GIS, Mail Services, and Facilities Security**.
* Lead and support departmental operations, staffing, payroll, budgeting, personnel administration, contracts, and major technology projects.
* Partner closely with the Director on **strategic planning, technology priorities, vendor relations, contract negotiations, and organizational initiatives**.
* Work with County leadership to identify technology needs, establish priorities, evaluate system capacity, and plan future equipment and technology investments.
* Help establish and maintain standards for computer hardware, software, systems, and technology services.
* Oversee the County’s GIS operations, including GIS data quality, web services, programming, and related centralized services.
* Provide leadership for Mail Services operations serving County facilities.
* Oversee Facilities Security technology, including electronic access control, alarms, and video security systems.
* Manage complex projects and help ensure departmental goals and service expectations are met.
* Build strong working relationships with County departments, vendors, employees, and members of the public.

What We’re Looking For

The successful candidate will bring strong leadership skills along with broad knowledge of modern information technology operations. We are looking for someone who can balance strategic thinking with the practical demands of managing people, projects, budgets, and critical technology services.

Strong candidates will have experience with areas such as:

* IT leadership and project management
* Application development and enterprise systems
* Networks, servers, telecommunications, and desktop technologies
* Relational databases and cloud-based solutions
* Website and content management technologies
* GIS principles and systems
* Information security and technology compliance
* Budgeting, contracts, procurement, and vendor management
* Hiring, developing, supervising, and evaluating staff
* Large-scale organizational or technology initiatives

The position requires strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to establish productive working relationships across departments and with the public.

Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Business, Administration, or a closely related field**
* Five years of information technology services experience
* Personnel management experience, preferably in a government environment

Preferred Qualifications

* Advanced degree in **Business or Public Administration**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related field
* Five years of personnel management experience, preferably in government

Additional Requirements

This position works primarily in a professional office environment and requires the ability to travel between County locations. A valid ability to operate a vehicle in accordance with County vehicle policies is required.

Why Boone County?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible leadership role supporting technology and essential services throughout Boone County government. The Deputy Director will have the opportunity to influence long-term technology strategy while working closely with County leadership and an experienced team of technology professionals.

**Benefit-eligible employees receive** paid vacation, 14 paid holidays, enrollment in the County Employees Retirement Fund, two matching deferred compensation plans, low- or no-cost employee health insurance options, County-paid employee dental coverage, subsidized dependent premiums, and County-paid life and long-term disability insurance.

Apply

Apply by clicking the **Apply Now** link or visiting www.boonemo.gov/hr. You will be directed to Boone County’s online application system, where you can create or log in to your applicant profile.

Questions? Call **(573) 886-4395**. Please contact us in advance if you need an accommodation to complete the application process.

Pay: $97,094.00 - $100,027.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field

Experience:

* personnel management: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

WEBIT Services, a Chicago-based Managed Services Provider, is seeking a qualified Virtual Chief Information Officer (vCIO) to join our team of Employee Owners. The role of the vCIO is to act as the client liaison for a specific set of assigned clients and own the post-sales side of the client lifecycle.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated vCIO to join our dynamic team. As a vCIO, you will support your clients post-sales need, including but not limited to: Client onboarding, project management, client maintenance-plan development, client policy and procedure development, client training and education, etc. The VCIO role will play a minor part in pre-sales working to ensure the proposed WEBIT solution stack fits with the client's needs properly. The vCIO will also plan, prepare and lead client Technology Business Reviews to ensure quality service and to align IT with the client's business objectives.

The VCIO must stay current with all WEBIT service offerings and must actively stay engaged to ensure the alignment between WEBIT Solutions and client needs. The role of the VCIO is challenging and rewarding and requires a strong and vast technical skill set along with business acumen and interpersonal skills. The focus of any job at WEBIT is always excellent customer service. We strive to make sure our clients are happy and that their networks are secure and running optimally.

**Responsibilities**

Pre-Sales

* Review final WEBIT Pre-Sales proposal documents BEFORE any proposal is made to clients. This is critical to ensure the vCIO is not handed a situation that doesn't fit with the WEBIT offerings.

*Post Sales*

* Conduct client end-user onboarding meetings with WEBIT Sales Rep to explain the WEBIT Onboarding process and show clients how to interact with our Help Desk. Ensure the client understands the process while emphasizing our commitment to Customer Service.

* Plan, communicate and set expectations for all remediation projects. Is the client liaison for all communications about the entire WEBIT Solutions Stack including all projects and ensure the Field/Project team is meeting the set expectations for time, customer service and quality.
* Work with the Field Team, Help Desk, other Impact departments and the sales team to plan, prepare for and conduct Technology Business Reviews (TBR's) meetings with clients.
* Keep all client management documentation up to date and continuously review for accuracy.
* Prepare and provide monthly ticket entry reports on all tickets entered by Help Desk, Field Team and vCIO roles per client.
* Lead technical discussions with clients as it relates to their business.
* Continuously work to provide the client with the right technology to accomplish business goals and objectives.

*Technical*

* Manage the client relationship from the WEEBIT perspective. Set goals and expectations for all aspects of WEBIT with the client.
* Work with the Field Team to create and review the technical project plans for remediation projects.
* Review pre-configured RMM reports and uses the RMM reporting features to provide client facing IT informational reports with insight that provides value to the client.
* Review reports for trends, commonalities, best practices, etc. and explain the findings in layman terms to client contacts.
* Demonstrate expert level knowledge of all WEBIT service offerings.
* Provide licensing guidelines, partner offerings, etc.
* Work with the Field Team and Help Desk teams to plan and implement the client management and maintenance plans that include Windows and 3rd party software patching, Line of Business application updates, A/V profiles and scan schedules, Workstation clean up, Active Directory management and all network documentation (Manage the process and ensure this work happens).
* Review, validate and edit all client documentation in the IT Glue DB for each assigned client.

*General*

* Participate in ongoing training and attainment of certifications.
* Develop and maintain relationships with customers that further develop our company's positive reputation through exceptional customer service.
* Maintain relationships with vendor contacts that are beneficial to the company.
* Work with Field Team and Director of Service to outline the long-term technology goals of each assigned client.
* Work with the WEBIT team to help define, streamline, improve and advance the vCIO role along with other WEBIT team initiatives.

*Professional Development*

* Develop personal skills to efficiently and effectively work individually and as a member of the WEBIT team.
* Participate in company-sponsored job-related activities and training to further develop your technical and interpersonal skills.
* Stay abreast of current IT trends, standards, solutions and services.
* Continuously works to learn about new technologies in general IT. Works to develop industry specific IT knowledge for the types of clients in their portfolio.
  

  
  
**Requirements**

Experience:

* 2+ Years as a vCIO/TAM (Technical Account Manager) for an Managed IT Service Provider
* Knowledge and awareness of the following:
* + Server Administration
  + Experience with Windows 2003-2016 Server
  + Active Directory design, management or maintenance
  + Microsoft Exchange, SQL, and SharePoint knowledge (base level)
  + DNS, DHCP, and other server-side networking technologies
  + VMWare, Hyper-V and other virtualization technologies
  + Storage solutions: SAN, NAS, Shared storage, ISCSI, Fiber Channel
  + Firewalls, switches and other networking technologies

When you join Veralto’s vibrant global network of 14 operating companies and 17,000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you’ll have boundless opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career.

Learn more about how our values influence our culture and who we are;

Learn about our leading portfolio of innovative products here!

**We offer:**

* A flexible work environment
* Paid holidays and a permissive paid time off policy emphasizing flexibility and trust
* Ongoing investment in your career through dedicated training, on-the-job development, and coaching
* Total rewards that support your success at work and beyond, including comprehensive health benefits, a 401(k) savings plan with employer match, and associate wellbeing programming with rewards

**About the role:**

The IT Internal Audit Director leads Veralto’s global IT internal audit strategy, encompassing risk-based IT reviews, IT SOX compliance, cybersecurity evaluations, and technology advisory. Serving as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and IT stakeholders, this role drives modern audit practices through data analytics, automation, and continuous risk monitoring. The Director manages a global team and co-source partners to deliver actionable, business-aligned insights across the enterprise. This position reports to the Chief Audit Executive and is part of the Internal Audit function, working closely with OpCo CIOs, IT compliance, and co-source partners, and serving as a key point of contact for segment management and operating companies. The role is preferred to be based at Veralto’s corporate headquarters in Waltham, MA, with a flexible work environment. Travel to operating companies may be required, estimated at up to 10% annually.

**In this role, a typical day will look like:**

* Develop and execute a global, risk-based IT and cyber audit strategy and annual audit plan covering technology operations, cybersecurity, cloud environments, ERP systems, infrastructure, applications, data governance, third-party technology risk, and IT SOX controls.
* Oversee IT SOX planning, scoping, testing, deficiency evaluation, remediation tracking, and coordination with co-source partners, external auditors, and control owners.
* Lead and supervise IT audits and advisory reviews from planning through reporting, ensuring high-quality workpapers, clear issue articulation, practical recommendations, and timely communication of results.
* Monitor emerging technology risks, including cybersecurity threats, cloud transformation, automation, AI governance, data privacy, system implementations, and technology-enabled business changes, to identify areas where Internal Audit may provide additional value to management.
* Communicate audit results, risk themes, control trends, remediation status, and changes to the audit plan to leadership, senior management, and external auditors, as appropriate.
* Partner with key executives and leaders across IT, cybersecurity, finance, compliance, and business operations to evaluate control design, strengthen governance, and support effective risk management routines across the enterprise.

At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society - the courts and justice system.

We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia. While our eSeries product suite enables governments and their employees to deliver continued foundational court processes, our R&D focuses on leveraging emerging possibilities with technology to improve access and efficiency.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Journal Technologies is a long-time, wholly-owned subsidiary of Daily Journal Corporation (NASDAQ: DJCO). We also have a major office in Logan, Utah, a team in Melbourne, Australia, an office in Victoria, Canada and a growing number of remote staff across North America.

Under our next generation of leadership, we're implementing a vision for the company that prioritizes building an extraordinary workplace with empowered people at the heart of our business. Great people want to collaborate with great people, and we are actively looking for smart, motivated people who care deeply about the work they do.

**Chief Technology Officer**

The Chief Technology Officer leads technology strategy, architecture, product development, and engineering across Journal Technologies. This leader sets and champions the technical vision, brings strong product and engineering thinking to every initiative, and ensures the company's platforms remain secure, reliable, and positioned for growth. The CTO works cross-functionally with every department and plays a central role in building out the new technology team described above, helping recruit talent and shape how new ideas are evaluated, developed, and scaled.

**What you'll do**

* Develop and lead a multi-year technology vision and roadmap aligned with the long-term goals of Journal Technologies and drive it across the organization.
* Bring a customer-centric, problem-first approach to product development, ensuring teams deeply understand user needs before committing to solutions.
* Identify emerging technologies and market opportunities that strengthen existing products and open new areas of value for the company.
* Advise executive leadership on technology investments, build-versus-buy decisions, and potential acquisitions or partnerships.
* Define architectural vision and principles, ensuring systems are configurable, repeatable, scalable, secure, appropriately modular, and engineered to upgrade and evolve over time.
* Apply platform thinking by promoting reusable services, APIs, and shared components that serve multiple products and business units.
* Own the modernization of the Company's technology portfolio, balancing investment in existing platforms with technical debt, modernization, consolidation, and next-generation capabilities.
* Lead the engineering organization with a culture grounded in ownership, craftsmanship, continuous improvement, and pragmatic decision-making.
* Maintain and advance modern engineering practices, balancing speed of delivery with quality, reliability, and security.
* Support our organization-wide transition to Agile methodologies and Scrum-at-Scale.
* Serve as a true partner to other departments, building alignment on priorities, timelines, and resources across the organization.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear business terms for non-technical stakeholders, and bring business context back to technical teams.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization, including organizational design, leadership development, succession planning, workforce strategy, and recruitment of critical technical capabilities needed for the Company's future.
* Ensure appropriate standards for security, privacy, compliance, and data governance, including requirements common to courts, government agencies, and criminal justice systems (such as CJIS).
* Oversee technology investment, performance, and operational resilience, ensuring resources are aligned with priorities and systems remain reliable, scalable, and prepared for business continuity.
* Establish effective technology governance and risk management, partnering with Security, Cloud Operations, IT, Legal, and business leaders to manage architectural, cybersecurity, regulatory, and third-party technology risks.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior technical leadership roles (CTO, VP of Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar).
* Proven experience leading and scaling engineering organizations and enterprise software platforms.
* Deep expertise in software and systems architecture, including distributed systems, cloud-native design, APIs, and data platforms.
* Strong product sense, with experience making customer-driven product decisions.
* A track record of setting a compelling technical vision and rallying teams and executives around it.
* Proven success working cross-functionally, with excellent communication skills and the ability to engage executives, engineers, customers, and partners alike.
* Background in government technology, justice or court systems, legal technology, or other regulated public sector markets is highly desirable.
* Experience incubating new products or working in a startup, innovation lab, or venture environment is preferred.
* Hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, and data-driven technologies to real products is preferred.

* **Build processes and program structures for scale:** Champion the development of scalable processes and adaptable program roadmaps designed to accommodate a rapid pace of innovation and commercialization

* Solid technical literacy in one or more areas: embedded systems, autonomy/AI, controls, sensing technologies, aerospace systems, wireless communications / RF systems
* Experience with vertical integration, supply chain and manufacturing management
* Exceptional communication skills: able to engage executive leadership, deep technical teams, and external partners with equal fluency

* High-ownership mindset: proactive, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in ambiguity

* Advanced degree preferred, but not required

new_jobs.title: Lead Principal Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Partners with senior management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services. Shapes and leads technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues. Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical collaboration across multiple teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and program goals. Provides expert technical guidance to shape and direct the automation of comprehensive reporting, leading collaboration with development teams to drive innovations in reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models for long-term technical program execution. Shapes the strategic direction of collaboration efforts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams for high-impact technical programs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:**

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Designs and shapes the strategy for product or service delivery, ensuring alignment with the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Integrates program demands and resourcing.

– Leads rapid response to the most critical security escalations, coordinating across teams and departments and serving as the primary point of contact to executives to assess risk, determine comprehensive mitigation strategies, and ensure alignment and execution of the most effective path to resolution.

– Leads the transformation and optimization of processes to ensure the highest reliability and resilience of products or services.

**Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:**

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Shapes overall planning activities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture.

– Defines and enforces delivery standards and guidelines, ensuring security, scalability, and alignment with best practices.

– Develops Line of Business (LOB) strategies for change management and/or incident response to enhance operational efficiency.

**Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:**

– Leads the alignment of priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services.

– Leads efforts to define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for LOB performance.

– Develops and communicates a comprehensive and strategic communication strategy of highly complex objectives to partners and customers.

**Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:**

– Shapes and leads both technical and non-technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides and mentors program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success), providing expert technical support and strategic direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Provides guidance on developing and maintaining comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and develops risk mitigation strategies.

– Ensures attention to detail, including security and quality, in program management, from planning to execution and reporting.

– Chairs regular program status meetings, fostering collaboration and driving effective communication across teams and leaders.

– Partners with leadership to set service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity benchmarks aligned with long-term business goals.

– Shapes and leads forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Leads the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, development, requirement changes, and support.

**Program Oversight - Risk Management:**

– Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues.

– Develops plans based on the results of cost assessments, benefits analysis, and return on investment (ROI) to improve decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Makes strategic decisions, balancing business needs, technical constraints, and long-term goals.

– Removes critical blockers for the program and determines optimal technical and resource options to drive the successful delivery and adoption of solutions.

**Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:**

– Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across the LOB.

– Leads the development and optimization of program objectives and workflows, while orchestrating the deployment of cross-functional solutions to address complex business problems.

– Collaborates with management to innovate and optimize processes and procedures to drive achievement of LOB goals.

**Pro
